description: This file contains a test implementation of a stream provider adapter factory for Orleans, specifically for testing cache creation and backpressure handling in EventHub stream providers. It defines classes for creating and managing caches, executing commands to check pressure status, and a factory method for instantiation.

classes.name: EHStreamProviderWithCreatedCacheListAdapterFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating and managing EventHub stream caches with testing capabilities, including cache pressure detection.

classes.name: CacheFactoryForTesting
classes.description: A specialized cache factory for testing, creating instances of QueueCacheForTesting and managing cache creation.

classes.name: QueueCacheForTesting
classes.description: A test implementation of EventHubQueueCache that also implements IQueueFlowController to monitor pressure state.

methods.name: CreateCacheFactory
methods.description: Creates a cache factory for testing, configured with shared dimensions and cache options.

methods.name: ExecuteCommand
methods.description: Executes commands to check cache pressure status or delegate to base implementation.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate the main adapter factory with options retrieved from the service provider.
